audit_protocol_delta.reason: Legacy S17 paragraph shards violated the campaign's unchanged rewrite-null rule; S18-S20 follow the corrected protocol.

carry_forward_constraints: Do not trust S20 reconcile_ok, idempotent, backup or structural flags until they are derived from executed checks rather than hardcoded JSON.
Do not treat master_intact=True as proof the generated workbook preserved the template; S20 must define supported Excel features and validate/review the output copy.
Do not consume S20 workbook totals until the generated workbook is reopened and totals plus row counts are reconciled to the same validated upstream payload.
Preserve S02 Decimal/integer-cent money semantics at the reporting boundary; S20 float +/-0.01 is not creditable as the PEN contract.
Do not consume pandas groupby pivots without explicit missing-key policy; default dropna can silently remove money from visible summaries.
Do not use S20 input_sha1_8 as authoritative provenance; use full SHA-256 and bind input, template, output, code version, dependency versions and run id.
S20 ISO date handling is PARTIAL until wb.iso_dates or an explicitly documented Excel serial-date contract is tested on the saved file.
S20 batch lock handling is PARTIAL; PermissionError from a fake opener is not a universal Excel lock model.
S20 corrupt handling is PARTIAL; BadZipFile is only one invalid-workbook failure surface.
Do not claim S20 batch robustness until size limit, bounded processing/timeout strategy, quarantine action, all counters and summary JSON are actually implemented.
S20 is missing roadmap-owned worksheet tables, defined names, Excel chart handling, workbook/worksheet protection and visual workbook tests; S21 must not assume those competencies are learned.
Keep S19 accessibility constraints active in S21: parity must include key/metric/value/denominator/filter/precision, and keyboard/focus/table semantics remain unresolved.
Keep S18 statistical/provenance constraints active: do not turn an uncertain or hand-authored analytical value into a polished report merely because S20 placed it in Excel.
